title: Stackdriver

fields.name: autoformat_stackdriver_trace
fields.description: Rewrite the trace field to include the projectID and format it for use with Cloud Trace.

fields.name: cloud_logging_base_url
fields.description: Set the base Cloud Logging API URL to use for the /v2/entries:write API request.

fields.name: compress
fields.description: Set payload compression mechanism.

fields.name: custom_k8s_regex
fields.description: Set a custom regular expression to extract fields like pod_name, namespace_name, container_name, and docker_id from the local_resource_id in logs.

fields.name: export_to_project_id
fields.description: The GCP project that should receive these logs.
fields.default: The `project_id` in the `google_service_credentials` file, or the `project_id` from Google's `metadata.google.internal` server.

fields.name: google_service_credentials
fields.description: Absolute path to a Google Cloud credentials JSON file.

fields.name: http_request_key
fields.description: The name of the key from the original record that contains the LogEntry's httpRequest.

fields.name: job
fields.description: An identifier for a grouping of related tasks, such as the name of a microservice or distributed batch.

fields.name: k8s_cluster_location
fields.description: The physical location of the cluster that contains (node or pod based on the resource type) the container.

fields.name: k8s_cluster_name
fields.description: The name of the cluster that the container (node or pod based on the resource type) is running in.

fields.name: labels
fields.description: Optional list of comma-separated strings specifying key=value pairs.

fields.name: labels_key
fields.description: The name of the key from the original record that contains the LogEntry's labels.

fields.name: location
fields.description: The GCP or AWS region in which to store data about the resource.

fields.name: log_name_key
fields.description: The name of the key from the original record that contains the logName value.

fields.name: metadata_server
fields.description: Prefix for a metadata server.
fields.default: Value of environment variable `$METADATA_SERVER`, or `http://metadata.google.internal` if unset.

fields.name: namespace
fields.description: A namespace identifier, such as a cluster name or environment.

fields.name: node_id
fields.description: A unique identifier for the node within the namespace, such as a hostname or IP address.

fields.name: project_id_key
fields.description: The value of this field is used by the Stackdriver output plugin to find the GCP projectID from jsonPayload and then extract the value of it to set the PROJECT_ID within LogEntry logName, which controls the GCP project that should receive these logs.
fields.default: logging.googleapis.com/projectId`. See [Stackdriver Special Fields](/manual/4.2/data-pipeline/outputs/stackdriver_special_fields.md#log-entry-fields) for more info.

fields.name: resource
fields.description: Set resource type of data.

fields.name: resource_labels
fields.description: An optional list of comma-separated strings specifying resource label plain text assignments (new=value) and mappings from an original field in the log entry to a destination field (destination=$original).

fields.name: service_account_email
fields.description: Account email associated with the service.

fields.name: service_account_secret
fields.description: Private key content associated with the service account.

fields.name: severity_key
fields.description: The name of the key from the original record that contains the severity.

fields.name: span_id_key
fields.description: The name of the key from the original record that contains the span ID.

fields.name: stackdriver_agent
fields.description: Set a custom User-Agent header value for requests sent to Cloud Logging.

fields.name: tag_prefix
fields.description: Set the tag_prefix used to validate the tag of logs with Kubernetes resource type.

fields.name: task_id
fields.description: A unique identifier for the task within the namespace and job, such as a replica index identifying the task within the job.

fields.name: test_log_entry_format
fields.description: Test-only option that prints the generated Cloud Logging payload without sending it.

fields.name: text_payload_key
fields.description: Set the key from the record to use as the textPayload field in the log entry.

fields.name: trace_key
fields.description: The name of the key from the original record that contains the trace value.

fields.name: trace_sampled_key
fields.description: The name of the key from the original record that contains the trace sampled flag.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of [workers](/manual/4.2/administration/multithreading.md#outputs) to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: The Stackdriver output plugin lets you ingest your records into the Google Cloud Stackdriver Logging service.
